by my
office.

Huh? It's none of your... Ugh, I guess it
is.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Same ol', same ol'. I took it easy and
spent my
time relaxing.

It seems like Нарита Таисин had a good
break.
